feature_name: Open Source QL Search for Event Logs
description: Move the advanced query language (QL) search functionality for event logs from the enterprise module to the open source codebase. This will make advanced event log searching available to all users without requiring an enterprise license. Update all relevant documentation to reflect this change.
functional_requirements: Move QL search implementation from enterprise module to core search components
Update API endpoints and schemas to include QL search for event logs in open source
Modify frontend search components to support QL queries without enterprise restrictions
Update client SDKs (Go, Rust, TypeScript) to reflect the moved functionality
Revise documentation to indicate QL search is now available in open source
Ensure all existing tests pass with the moved functionality
